args.description: Game prop reference of the watchtower from the reference image, seen from the front at the game's camera angle, slightly from above. The reference shows a stone watchtower in a village with houses, trees and figures around it; draw only the single tower and nothing else. Same design: a tall square watchtower of grey stone blocks with a few small dark arrow-slit windows, a wooden lookout platform on top with a wooden railing and four corner posts holding a pointed dark wooden shingle roof, a small wooden door at its foot. Seen square from the front, the door at the centre of its foot. Match the rendering style of the second reference image exactly: the same chunky voxel pixel-art look, block size, outline-free shading and soft lighting, but not its subject. The whole watchtower from its top to the ground it stands on, upright, centred, nothing cropped. Plain flat white background, no ground, no grass, no shadow, no text, no other objects. One single watchtower only, not a sheet of several.
